solver: At realized post-trade cash/labor and lots, exact integer reference with grain/cash/idle and incremental wage cost; four or fewer plots also enumerate. No use of contemporaneous survey state to decide.
candidate_rule: Only implement bounded economic search correction if exact optimal strictly improves the realized objective AND converts at least two percent of crop-comparable families from pure to mixed, averaged on two seeds and two endpoint years. No crop-yield, floor or intensity parameter is tuned. A second-season candidate requires independently interpretable season-specific inputs and time budgets; otherwise do not infer rotation from annual intensity.
historical_retain_rule: On full 20 paired seeds require a fall of at least 0.02 in mean mixed error or 0.05 in mean grain relative error, no other threshold metric worse by more than 0.02 absolute, and clean accounts. Same five original levels [0.10,0.10,0.15,0.10,0.10]. Single-season physical vs annual mu-times is descriptive, not a compatible five-way pass. If unsupported keep M1.
screened_openings: Run one uniform exploration action per year; store development opening snapshots before action. Within each public state take first ten distinct parent paths by sorted seed. If below 95%, screen one additional block and top up deterministically for underfilled states only, maintaining the cap. Disjoint holdout seeds.
stability_fit: One prespecified repeated fit on the same frozen branches excluding parent seeds divisible by four; compare both repeated Q and myopic on the same holdout separately. Never substitute it for main.
primary_analysis: Main Q minus strongest developer fixed and same-information myopic; 6 simultaneous endpoints: 8-year physical grain kg and paid yuan, and years 7-8 grain after own year-6 withdrawal, Bonferroni paired t with family alpha .05. No cost-equivalence or noninferiority margin.
allocation_pulse: Opening counterfactual: first year concentrate the same broad preplant instrument on Central vs West, then both use the prespecified all-region equal broad preplant template in years 2-8. Same seed and four regional shocks; six separately interpreted windows/stock diagnostics, no training gate.
scope: Retain parent 21 actions, identical regional observations, 98953 yuan cap, 8 active years and paired stop. Four-zone real-code mechanism test; independent family panel absent.
